entries.text: Bundle validation refuses a compliance_class that is not official, unofficial_nonstandard or unofficial_subscale; an off-list scale previously let any value through.
TPC-DI result bundles record the data-generation seed in the optional field benchmark.data_generation_seed. Existing bundles are unchanged.

Eighteen TPC-DI bundles made by earlier data generators are labelled superseded-data-generator instead of defective-variant-or-loader-wrong-result. They stay out of the rankings and their displayed reason is unchanged.
